system.description: Adds two dances, both keyed to the Fencer's Stances. Crane Dance: recover 3 HP or MP when a creature misses you; both while in Parry Stance. Viper Dance: gain Resistance to poison, or convert your damage to poison; doubles on an Accuracy or Magic Check while in Lunge Stance inflict poisoned. Reachable through Dancer mastery alone — the Stance clauses only pay off if the character is also a Fencer.
